<translate>
<!--T:1-->
Quick answers to the most common questions and issues that players and server owners run into. If your problem isn't here, follow the links to the reference pages, or start from the [[Special:MyLanguage/Beginner's Guide|Beginner's Guide]] if you are new to the mod.
</translate>

<translate>
== For players == <!--T:2-->

=== Why can't I use ki attacks or strike attacks? === <!--T:3-->

<!--T:4-->
Ki and strike techniques need the [[Special:MyLanguage/Ki Control|Ki Control]] skill (every master teaches it), at least '''5% Power Release''' (hold {{Key|C}} to charge) and an '''empty main hand'''. Evasion techniques have the same requirements. See [[Special:MyLanguage/Techniques|Techniques]] and [[Special:MyLanguage/Skills|Skills]].

=== Why can't I fly? === <!--T:5-->

<!--T:6-->
Flight needs both the [[Special:MyLanguage/Fly|Fly]] and [[Special:MyLanguage/Ki Control|Ki Control]] skills, and at least '''5% Power Release''' to take off. Press {{Key|F}} to toggle it. See [[Special:MyLanguage/Controls|Controls]].

=== How do I change the flight mode? === <!--T:7-->

<!--T:8-->
There are two flight modes, '''Combat''' and '''Search'''. Hold the '''Second Function''' key ({{Key|Left Alt}} by default) and press the [[Special:MyLanguage/Fly|Fly]] key ({{Key|F}} by default) to switch between them. You can also switch it, cap your flight speed and turn on '''Mode Lock''' from the Utility Menu ('''Movement → Fly'''). See [[Special:MyLanguage/Combat#Combat flight|Combat]].

=== Why won't a master teach me? === <!--T:9-->

<!--T:10-->
Some masters lock their '''Skills''', '''Train''' and new quests until your [[Special:MyLanguage/Alignment|alignment]] fits: Good masters need 61 or more and Cell and Frieza 40 or less. Hover the locked option to see why. You also have to be within 10 blocks of a master who offers the skill, and your race has to be allowed to learn it. See [[Special:MyLanguage/Masters|Masters]].

=== Why does my transformation keep dropping? === <!--T:11-->

<!--T:12-->
Every form drains a resource (usually Ki) while it is active. If you can't pay the drain, the form and any stack form are switched off and you return to base. Raise the form's '''mastery''' (it lowers the drain), power down (the drain scales with your Power Release) or invest in '''Energy''' for a bigger Ki pool. See [[Special:MyLanguage/Transformations|Transformations]] and [[Special:MyLanguage/Training Points and Mastery#Mastery|Training Points and Mastery]].

=== Can I change my race, class or looks? === <!--T:13-->

<!--T:14-->
The '''Re-Customize''' wish ([[Special:MyLanguage/Shenron|Shenron]] or [[Special:MyLanguage/Porunga|Porunga]]) reopens the customization screen: you can change your appearance and class, but not your race, and you keep your stats and skills. Picking another race takes a full character reset, which wipes your progress. Mr. Popo's '''Haircut''' reopens the hair editor at any time. A Human can become an [[Special:MyLanguage/Android|Android]] through [[Special:MyLanguage/Dr. Gero|Dr. Gero]]. See [[Special:MyLanguage/Character Customization|Character Customization]].

=== Can I change my story difficulty? === <!--T:15-->

<!--T:16-->
The difficulty you pick the first time you open the Quests tab is permanent. The only way to change it is the '''Change Difficulty''' wish, which lets you choose again the next time you open the Quest Tree without resetting your saga progress. Joining a party on a higher difficulty also raises yours permanently. See [[Special:MyLanguage/Sagas|Sagas]].

=== How do I redistribute my stats? === <!--T:17-->

<!--T:18-->
Porunga's '''Reallocate Stats''' wish lets you redistribute your attribute points, and admins can do the same with <code>/dmzstats relocate</code> (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Commands#Resetting a character without losing stats|Commands]]). Dende's '''Reset Stats''' service at [[Special:MyLanguage/Kami's Lookout|Kami's Lookout]] is a full character reset and asks for confirmation first.

=== What happens when I die? === <!--T:19-->

<!--T:20-->
With the Otherworld enabled, your spirit goes to the [[Special:MyLanguage/Otherworld|Otherworld]] with a halo instead of respawning normally. While dead you don't get hungry and you earn double TP. [[Special:MyLanguage/Fortuneteller Baba|Fortuneteller Baba]] can let you "borrow time" in the living world, and the dragons' revive wishes bring dead players fully back to life (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Dragons and Wishes|Dragons and Wishes]]).
</translate>

<translate>
== For server owners == <!--T:21-->

=== "Priceless" forms or broken form values === <!--T:22-->

<!--T:23-->
A form shows '''"Priceless"''' in the Skills menu when its skill level has no TP cost and no quest grants it. If that happens to DragonMineZ's own forms, your form or skill config files are broken or were edited into an invalid state.

<!--T:24-->
DragonMineZ upgrades outdated config files on its own after an update (see [[Special:MyLanguage/How to JSON|How to JSON]]), so first check the server log or the JSON load report in chat for a file that failed to load, fix it and run <code>/dmzreload config</code>.

<!--T:25-->
'''Last resort:''' close the game or server, move the <code>dragonminez</code> folder out of your <code>config</code> folder (keep it as a backup), then start back up. DragonMineZ regenerates the config from its current defaults.
</translate>

{{Note|type=warning|<translate><!--T:26--> This only resets the '''config''' (<code>config/dragonminez</code>), not your world save or player progress. Any custom edits you made to those config files will be gone from the new files, so copy back what you need from your backup. See [[Special:MyLanguage/Reloading and Updating Changes|Reloading and Updating Changes]].</translate>}}

<translate>
=== Quests bugged after updating from an older version === <!--T:27-->
</translate>
{{Config|General Server Config|autoUpdateQuests}}
<translate>
<!--T:28-->
DragonMineZ upgrades the default quest, saga and side-quest files of your world automatically when it starts (unless the server turned automatic quest updates off), keeping your edits. If quests are still stuck or bugged after an update, it is usually leftover story data from the previous version.

<!--T:29-->
'''Fix:''' run <code>/dmzrestoreupdate</code> and confirm it (click the button, or run <code>/dmzrestoreupdate confirm</code> within 15 seconds). It '''deletes''' everything in the world's <code>dragonminez/wishes</code>, <code>sagas</code> and <code>quests</code> folders and regenerates the defaults for the current version, so back up any custom quests or wishes first. See [[Special:MyLanguage/Commands|Commands]].

=== My config edits were reset or didn't apply === <!--T:30-->
</translate>

* <translate><!--T:31--> '''Syntax error:''' DragonMineZ couldn't read the file. It runs on default values for that file and leaves your file untouched; the log (and the JSON load report in chat) shows the file, line and column. Fix it and run <code>/dmzreload config</code>.</translate>
* <translate><!--T:32--> '''After a DragonMineZ update:''' outdated files are regenerated with the new defaults and your changed values merged back in. The previous file is in <code>config/dragonminez/oldBackup/</code>.</translate>
* <translate><!--T:33--> '''Typo in a key name:''' unknown keys are ignored and listed in the JSON load report.</translate>
* <translate><!--T:34--> '''Edited <code>general-user.json</code> by hand:''' that file is read by the client; restart the game, or change the option from the in-game Config tab.</translate>

<translate>
<!--T:35-->
See [[Special:MyLanguage/How to JSON|How to JSON]] and [[Special:MyLanguage/Configuration|Configuration]].

=== Players see a "JSON load report" in chat when they join === <!--T:36-->
</translate>
{{Config|General Server Config|developer.reportJsonProblemsInChat}}
<translate>
<!--T:37-->
That report lists JSON files that failed to load and default files DragonMineZ upgraded. Fix the listed files and run <code>/dmzreload</code>, or turn the report off in the developer section of [[Special:MyLanguage/General Server Config|General Server Config]].

=== Mod structures aren't spawning === <!--T:38-->
</translate>
{{Config|General Server Config|generateCustomStructures}}
<translate>
<!--T:39-->
First check that custom structure generation is turned on in [[Special:MyLanguage/General Server Config|General Server Config]]. You can also place DragonMineZ structures manually with the vanilla <code>/place</code> command:
</translate>

<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
/place structure dragonminez:<structure>
</syntaxhighlight>

<translate>
<!--T:40-->
For example, <code>/place structure dragonminez:goku_house</code>. Type <code>/place structure dragonminez:</code> and use tab-completion to see every available structure. See [[Special:MyLanguage/Structures|Structures]].
</translate>

{{Note|type=tip|<translate><!--T:41--> <code>/dmzlocate</code> finds where an already-generated structure is, for example <code>/dmzlocate goku_house</code> (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Commands|Commands]]).</translate>}}
